content_zh:
越想越觉得不妙，小说里，佟妃先是为了争宠，后是为了替三皇子铺路，手上可没少沾血。
甚至连养寇自重的事，她都干过——暗中让她在沿海抗倭的哥哥不要彻底剿灭倭寇，让皇帝始终厚待他们兄弟俩。
佟妃是个有手腕的女人，和单纯的汐妃不一样，自然不好糊弄。
薛遥抬眼看了看身旁跟着的俩太监，心想干脆假装有东西落在汐妃宫里了，要求回去取，那样就有机会寻求汐妃的庇护。
他好歹是为了帮助汐妃才惹上佟妃的，汐妃应该会庇护他。
薛遥脚步略微放慢，刚想开口，又止住。
脑子里飞快地琢磨：如果现在心虚地投靠汐妃，那他给佟妃使绊子的罪名，可就坐实了。
就佟妃那样的手段，汐妃要自保都很艰难，又怎么能一直庇护住他？
他迟早是要跟佟妃对峙的，现在耍滑能逃过一劫，却逃不过一世，反而会让佟妃对他更加关注，甚至仇视。
这么一想，薛遥就没再犹豫，跟随太监去面见佟妃。
佟妃住在临佑宫，跟延春阁相邻，未踏进宫门，便闻花香扑鼻，外院的景致比汐妃的青穹殿美多了。
也不知是因为沾了她哥的光，还是她很得宠幸。
太监领着薛遥，至偏殿拜见佟妃，还没来得及请安，左右就有内侍上来搜薛遥的身。
薛遥的香囊被内侍搜出来，转交给贵妃椅上的佟妃，
佟妃今年二十九岁，看着很年轻，饱满的额头、圆圆的杏眼，皮肤不太白皙，是健康的小麦色，也没有刻意用脂粉遮掩，气质高贵。
她神色平和地接过香囊闻了一下，就交给侍女，温声吩咐：“查查配方是不是完全一样，先别通知方坵。”
气味是一样的，如果配方也完全一样，那她身边就一定有内鬼泄露了香囊的配方。
香囊的事，总共三个知情人，其中最值得怀疑的，就是那配置药方的道士方坵。
薛遥低着头，很是惊慌，在这种专业宫斗十多年的女人面前，智商隐隐有种被碾压的感觉。
“薛承大人家的二公子？”佟妃语调温和地开口。

“娘娘万福。”薛遥应声请安。
佟妃说：“把头抬起来，看着我。”
薛遥紧张地抬起头，对视的瞬间，只感觉这女人那双幽深的黑瞳仿佛x光，能把他看个透。
“你主子是哪位？”佟妃平静地开口。
薛遥躬身回道：“小人给三皇子侍读，三皇子是小人的主子，娘娘也是小人的主子。”
“我问的是派你提醒汐妃的那位主子。”
“小人不明白娘娘的意思，提醒汐妃娘娘什么？”
佟妃满意的一笑：“这点年纪，这么沉得住气，可造之材。”
薛遥已经快吓尿了，仍旧装作一脸茫然。
佟妃说：“本宫听说了你在青穹殿的表现，真是一场精彩绝伦的表演，连我的探子都被你唬住了，以为你娘真有这么只香囊。”
薛遥眨了眨眼，笑道：“娘娘也喜欢这香囊？小人可以让母亲给您配一包新的。”
佟妃沉默，看着他的目光渐渐冰冷。
薛遥扬起嘴角，露出最诚挚的笑，硬着头皮继续装傻：“这香味是顶好闻的！”
佟妃笑了：“我真是越来越欣赏你这小鬼头了，今年多大了？”
“差三个月九岁。”
“真是英雄出少年。”佟妃细细打量薛遥：“你的家世我了解，你父亲官儿当得不怎么舒坦，希望都落在你和你兄弟肩上了吧？你兄长在大皇子身边，你却被送来我家老三身边，是在帮大皇子盯着咱们？”
薛遥暗道不好。
这女人实在太聪明，脑子里绕了八百个弯，他光听着都有点发愣。
但薛遥并不是大皇子的内鬼，救汐妃，完全是他一时冲动的意愿，背后没有任何人指使。
但是，让佟妃误会自己是大皇子的人，倒也不错，至少能保命。

大皇子是皇后所出的嫡长子，名正言顺的储君，要不是未来他联合内阁施行的那套变法，闹出了大乱子，也不会彻底垮台。
目前，大皇子的地位还是远超佟妃的，假装是大皇子的腿毛，会很安全。
所以，薛遥没否认，只装傻充愣地笑笑。
佟妃心里很疑惑，猜测薛遥是大皇子安插在她儿子身边的眼线，但大皇子为什么要管汐妃的闲事？
汐妃凭借美色博得圣宠，就连皇后对她也有几分妒意。
佟妃使绊子，实际上是皇后默许的，那大皇子又为什么让薛遥去提醒汐妃？

content_en:
The more I think about it, the more ominous I feel. In the novel, Concubine Tong is first trying to win favor, and then she is trying to pave the way for the third prince, and there is a lot of blood on her hands.
She even did something to help the Japanese pirates respect themselves - secretly asking her brother who was fighting against the Japanese pirates on the coast not to completely annihilate the Japanese pirates, so that the emperor would always treat the two brothers favorably.
Concubine Tong is a smart woman, unlike the simple Concubine Xi, so naturally she is not easy to fool.
Xue Yao raised his eyes and looked at the two eunuchs following him, thinking that he might as well pretend that something was left in Concubine Xi's palace and ask to go back to get it, so that he would have a chance to seek Concubine Xi's protection.
After all, he got into trouble with Concubine Tong just to help Concubine Xi, and Concubine Xi should protect him.
Xue Yao slowed down slightly. He was about to speak, but stopped.
He was thinking quickly in his mind: If he now surrenders to Concubine Xi with a guilty conscience, then he will be charged with stumbling upon Concubine Tong.
With Concubine Tong's methods, it was very difficult for Concubine Xi to protect herself, so how could she keep protecting him?
Sooner or later, he will have to confront Concubine Tong. Now he can escape by being slippery, but he cannot escape forever. Instead, Concubine Tong will pay more attention to him and even hate him.
With this thought, Xue Yao did not hesitate anymore and followed the eunuch to meet Concubine Tong.
Concubine Tong lived in Linyou Palace, adjacent to Yanchun Pavilion. Before stepping into the palace gate, she could smell the fragrance of flowers. The scenery in the outer courtyard was much more beautiful than Concubine Xi's Qingqiong Palace.
I don’t know if it’s because of her brother’s favor, or because she’s very favored.
The eunuch led Xue Yao to the side hall to pay homage to Concubine Tong. Before he could say hello, there were servants on the left and right who came up to search Xue Yao.
Xue Yao's sachet was found by the chamberlain and handed to Concubine Tong on the imperial concubine's chair.
Concubine Tong is twenty-nine years old this year. She looks very young. She has a full forehead, round almond eyes, and her skin is not too fair, but a healthy wheat color. She is not deliberately covered with makeup, and her temperament is noble.
She took the sachet with a calm expression, smelled it, handed it to the maid, and gently ordered: "Check whether the formula is exactly the same. Don't inform Fang Qiu yet."
The smell is the same, and if the formula is exactly the same, then there must be a mole around her who leaked the formula of the sachet.
There were a total of three insiders about the sachet, and the most suspicious of them was the Taoist priest Fang Qiu who prepared the prescription.
Xue Yao lowered his head and was very panicked. In front of such a woman who has been professionally engaged in palace fighting for more than ten years, his IQ felt like he was being crushed.
"The second young master of Mr. Xue Cheng's family?" Concubine Tong said in a gentle tone.
"Happy queen." Xue Yao said hello.
Concubine Tong said: "Raise your head and look at me."
Xue Yao raised his head nervously. The moment they looked at each other, he felt that the woman's deep black pupils were like X-rays, able to see through him.
"Who is your master?" Concubine Tong said calmly.
Xue Yao bowed and replied: "The villain reads to the third prince. The third prince is the villain's master, and the empress is also the villain's master."
"I'm asking about the master who sent you to remind Concubine Xi."
"I don't understand what your Majesty means. What should I remind you, Concubine Xi?"
Concubine Tong smiled with satisfaction: "At this young age, he is so calm and composed. He is a talented person."
Xue Yao was almost scared to death, but still pretended to be confused.
Concubine Tong said: "I heard about your performance in the Qingqiong Palace. It was such a wonderful performance that even my spies were fooled by you, thinking that your mother really had such a sachet."
Xue Yao blinked and said with a smile: "Your Majesty, you also like this sachet? I can ask my mother to give you a new sachet."
Concubine Tong was silent, looking at him with gradually cold eyes.
Xue Yao raised the corners of his mouth, showed the most sincere smile, and continued to act stupid: "This fragrance is the most delicious!"
Concubine Tong smiled: "I really appreciate you as a little devil more and more. How old are you this year?"
"Three months to nine years old."
"It's true that a hero comes from a young age." Concubine Tong looked at Xue Yao carefully: "I understand your family background. Your father's job as an official was not very comfortable. All hopes fall on the shoulders of you and your brother, right? Your brotherYou grew up next to the eldest prince, but you were sent to live with my youngest son. Are you helping the eldest prince keep an eye on us? "
Xue Yao secretly thought it was not good.
This woman was so smart that she made eight hundred twists and turns in her mind. He was a little dazed just listening to her.
But Xue Yao was not the eldest prince's mole. It was entirely his impulse to save Concubine Xi, without anyone's instructions behind his back.
However, it would not be bad if Concubine Tong misunderstood that she was the eldest prince, at least she could save her life.
The eldest prince is the eldest son of the empress, and he is a legitimate prince. If it were not for the reforms implemented by his coalition cabinet in the future, which caused a big mess, he would not have completely collapsed.
At present, the status of the eldest prince is still far superior to that of Concubine Tong. It will be safe to pretend to be the eldest prince's leg hair.
Therefore, Xue Yao did not deny it, but just pretended to be stupid and smiled.
Concubine Tong was very confused, guessing that Xue Yao was the eldest prince's spy around her son, but why did the eldest prince want to meddle in Concubine Xi's business?
Concubine Xi won the favor with her beauty, and even the queen was a little jealous of her.
Concubine Tong's trip was actually approved by the queen, so why did the eldest prince ask Xue Yao to remind Concubine Xi?
